name: Claire Argyris
source: She’s pretty small, so everyone thinks she’s a little girl the first time they meet her, and it's not like her personality helps to dispel the misunderstanding either. In front of Ciarán she’s bright and happy, always speaks her mind no matter how crazy it is and is also funny in her own way. But with anyone else she’s really shy, to the point that she can barely talk with them. Sometimes she seems to get serious and any conversation with her becomes incredibly weird, but it’s not usually for a long time. She’s also kinda wild and sometimes plays hooky from school.
